text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with North Flight...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Look, it's a "Paka Petit"!
Isn't it cute?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction North Flight was pointing, there was a claw crane game
filled with plushies styled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even though it's stylized as a chibi,
it's made very faithfully to the original.
Look, even the outfit design is captured accurately.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The lining and the stitching are...
No, from here I can't really—
choice_data_list: Then I'll just have to win it! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you sure?
Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll be cheering you on
with all my might♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
